def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import glob
    import os

    paths = [
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2022.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2016.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2018.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2009.csv",

        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2014.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2006.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2008.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2019.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2004.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2007.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2003.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2012.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2017.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2021.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2015.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2020.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2011.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2023.csv",
    ]

    matched = []
    for p in paths:
        ms = glob.glob(p)
        if not ms:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No files matched path: {p}")
        matched.extend(ms)

    frames = []
    for fp in sorted(set(matched)):
        base = os.path.basename(fp)
        year = None
        # expected: water-body-testing-YYYY.csv
        try:
            year = int(base.split('-')[-1].split('.')[0])
        except Exception:
            year = None
        df = pd.read_csv(fp, dtype=str)
        df['sourceFile'] = base
        df['year'] = year
        frames.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True, sort=False)
    return out

def process(loadAllYears):
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadAllYears.copy()

    # Restrict to years in scope (2002-2023 inclusive)
    df = df[(df['year'] >= 2002) & (df['year'] <= 2023)]

    # Marine beaches only
    marine = df[df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'marine'].copy()

    # Normalize violation flag; treat missing/unknown as non-violation unless explicitly yes
    v = marine['Violation'].astype('string')
    vNorm = v.str.strip().str.lower()
    marine['isViolation'] = vNorm.eq('yes')

    # A beach is "always safe" if it has zero violations across all its records.
    # If a beach has no data for a year, it doesn't appear, and is assumed safe for that year.
    perBeach = (
        marine.groupby('Beach Name', dropna=False)['isViolation']
        .any()
        .reset_index(name='anyViolation')
    )

    alwaysSafe = perBeach[~perBeach['anyViolation']]

    return pd.DataFrame([{'alwaysSafeMarineBeachesCount': int(alwaysSafe.shape[0])}])
input.summary: Count marine beaches (Beach Type Description='Marine') in years 2002-2023 that had zero recorded violations across all available samples: normalize Violation to lowercase/trim; set isViolation=True only when Violation=='yes'; group by Beach Name and compute any(isViolation); count beaches with anyViolation=False; return single-row DataFrame with alwaysSafeMarineBeachesCount
